column1: # H1 main plan (reports/H1-main-packet.md; MOT1 v6 §1, decided 2026-10-16; no change of mixes, SLOs or datasets).
# One row per workload x mix, in run order within a workload; workload order = first appearance (h1-main.sh).
#   mix       mix tag used in run names (<sys>-<mix>-slo-r<r>, <sys>-<mix>-fix-r<k>)
#   param     the workload block's mix parameter (passed to the hook verbatim in H1_MIXES as <mix>=<param>)
#   factor    fixed-load rate argument = L_x x factor, L_x in the SLO run's x units (loadgen summary confirm.x_mean):
#             vector DB x = search/s, rate = total of the search + update streams = x / (1 - U/100);
#             KV / LMDB x = mixed requests/s (factor 1); DLRM x = query/s (updater rate fixed by the Ekko rule; 1)
#   round     decimals of the rate argument (KV/LMDB blocks take integer rates: 0)
#   slo       the SLO (stream:pct:ms) every run of the row must report in summary.json (checked by levels.py)
#   label     mix name in the figures
